lastCompletedStory.title: Install per-session window-resized hook that re-clamps dashboard width

nextStoryContext: US-003 adds a set-hook call at the end of ensureProjectSession (5th spawn, index 4). Hook uses run-shell with #{window_width} expanded by tmux to a literal int before sh -c receives it; shell $((w*20/100)) and $((t<34?34:t>52?52:t)) produce the clamped literal for resize-pane -x. Empirically verified on tmux 3.6a (probe socket cam48probe): w=100 -> 34, w=300 -> 52, w=220 -> 44. Only remaining story is US-004 which requires operator ceremony.

officialDocsValidated.summary: set-hook -t <session> window-resized 'run-shell ...' confirmed working on tmux 3.6a. resize-pane -x rejects #{...} format expressions (width invalid) - constraint #1 verified. run-shell expands #{window_width} to a numeric literal before passing to sh -c, enabling shell $((  )) arithmetic for the clamp. Probe session on socket cam48probe confirmed: w=100->pane 34, w=300->pane 52, w=220->pane 44.
